description.label: Description
description.value:
Trivial Physical Mutation

You gain a small bestial feature somewhere on your body. Roll on the @Table[hitloc]{Hit Locations} Table to determine which part of the body is affected, and then on the @Table[bestial-body]{Bestial Body} Table below to see which type of beast that lends its features to you. The alteration is something relatively trivial. On the head an eye or an ear might turn bestial, whereas on a leg it could be a patch of feathers or some froglike webbing between the toes - the GM decides the specifics. The change is entirely cosmetic.
